description:
Located in one of the most exclusive and highly sought-after residential areas of Ashbourne, this exceptional B2 rated five-bedroom, four-bathroom home offers a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial family residence extending to approximately 353m2 (3,800 sq. ft) on a beautifully maintained site of c. 0.67 acres.

Designed with both comfort and modern living in mind, this impressive home boasts generous and well-proportioned accommodation throughout, complemented by an Air to water heat system, plus underfloor heating on both the ground and first floors. The property is presented to a high standard and offers an ideal balance of space, style and practicality for contemporary family life.

The accommodation briefly comprises of a spacious entrance lobby, kitchen with open plan living / dining area, two receptions, gym / home office / 3rd reception, utility room, five bedrooms (2 ensuite) and a main bathroom with free standing bath. There is also a shower room / guest WC on the ground floor.

Outside, the home enjoys a superb South-East facing garden, allowing for excellent natural light throughout the day, along with attractive patio areas to the rear and side of the property, ideal for outdoor dining, entertaining and relaxing. There is also an electric car charger, and the grounds are further enhanced by electric gates to the front, providing privacy and security, as well as a c. 185m2 / 2,000 sq. ft outbuilding offering excellent potential for a variety of uses (spp).

The property is located on the south side of Ashbourne. Ashbourne is a thriving commuter town in Co. Meath.  It is strategically located in the South of County Meath and is an important town with a growing population. Situated on the M2 motorway, Ashbourne links to the M50, the Dublin Orbital Motorway in just 15 minutes, and within 21 minutes links to Dublin Airport.  In recent years, Ashbourne has seen rapid development with the creation of a brand-new town centre and streetscapes. The town now boasts six Primary Schools, to include St. Declan’s National School, St. Mary’s National School, Ashbourne Educate Together National School, Gaelscoil Na Colle, Gaelscoil Na Mí and Ashbourne Community National School.  There are also two Secondary schools; Ashbourne Community School and Coláiste De Lacy.
To arrange a viewing, contact DNG Tormey Lee on 01 835 7089 or send an email via this advert.
